sloka: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामो विभीषणमरिन्दमम् ।अहो दीप्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।। ६.५९.२६ ।।।।
transliteration: pratyuvāca tato rāmo vibhīṣaṇamarindamam ।aho dīpto mahātejā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।। 6.59.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Rama the scourge of enemies replied Vibheeshana, "Oh! Ravana! King of Rakshasas is endowed with luminous glory."
